messages:
Ravi CS: Heads-up 1: Delta (customer) wants dedicated capacity kickover next week. We need a concise onramp play: staggered throttle, autoscale knobs, and a pre-cutover load script. Can eng/sre confirm safe windows?
Elena SRE: Proposed windows: 08:00-10:00 10% (safety), 10:00-13:00 30%, 13:00-16:00 60%, 16:00+ full. Each window should have a 30min observation hold.
Priya Platform: OK. I'll translate to quota windows in the control plane. Suggest autoscale policy: target 65% GPU util, cool-down 3m, scale step +15%. Also enable transient burst allowance +25% for 10m per window.
Omar CS: Delta prefers quicker ramp if p95 < 300ms and success rate > 99.5% for 20m. They're also sensitive to unexpected billing spikes. Ravi, can you confirm contract burst tolerances?
Ravi CS: On it. Contract allows 2 bursts per month up to +20% over committed without extra charge; anything beyond is billable after sign-off. Will confirm with finance.
Taylor Eng: Add a fallback routing plan. If p99 > 600ms for 3 minutes straight or error rate > 1.5% we will: 1) send 25% of traffic to redwood-2-quant (lower fidelity), 2) reduce quota windows by 40%, 3) trigger a rollback to prior model variant.
Elena SRE: I'll wire a health gate: metric p95_request_latency > 350ms sustained 10m -> health=false event. That toggles a feature flag the router listens to.
Priya Platform: For token caps, setting per-customer daily cap = 1.2x committed tokens for first 72 hours post-cutover, then tighten to committed. Helps early churn.
Ian (Delta): That token cap should be fine. We'll throttle client retries to 2 and backoff base 200ms. Also we can enable 10% sampling for debug traces during the 30% and 60% windows.
Taylor Eng: Load script I'll use for the burn (run from loadbot):
```
# k8s job using gatling wrapper
./loadbot run --target https://staging-infer.redwood.ai/v1/chat --concurrency 800 --duration 12m \
  --payload-file tests/payloads/customer_small.json --rate 800/s --headers "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
Elena SRE: Running a preflight today at 14:00 UTC against staging pool (eu-central). Plan: three waves: 200rps x15m, 600rps x20m, 1.1k rps x12m. I'll collect p50/p95/p99, retry counts, OOMs, GPU memory spikes.
loadbot: scheduled run by Elena SRE for 2024-09-12T14:00:00Z. Results will be posted to /var/logs/loadbot/delta-preflight-2024-09-12.log
Omar CS: Ops ask: can we have an SLO dashboard snapshot commitable to the customer before each ramp? We should show token burn, latencies, errors, and cost burn projections.
Priya Platform: Yes. I'll export dashboard snapshots and cost projection CSVs for each window.
Ravi CS: Legal confirmed: burst up to +20% included; beyond that is billable. I'll notify the customer and loop in finance pre-cutover.
Elena SRE: Preflight quick summary: 200rps stable p95=95ms p99=160ms; 600rps p95=180ms p99=320ms; 1.1k p95=290ms p99=520ms with a couple 750ms spikes. No OOMs, minor GC pauses on one node. Full log: /var/logs/loadbot/delta-preflight-2024-09-12.log
Taylor Eng: Good. Action items: Priya push quota windows to control plane, Elena upload full telemetry & hook health gate, I (Taylor) add fallback routing rules, Ravi confirm contract and send sign-off to Ian, Omar prepare enablement notes for Delta on client retry/backoff and sampling.
Ian (Delta): We'll review the preflight log and confirm asap. If all looks green, approve fast-path to 60% within the same day.
Ravi CS: Thanks team. I'll collect these action items and schedule a final go/no-go call 2024-09-13 09:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
